violated_contract: An OAuth callback failure page that embeds provider response bodies or exception messages into an HTMLResponse must HTML-escape them: HTMLResponse defaults to text/html, so a raw provider body or an exception message carrying a crafted URL executes as markup in the browser even without page markup around it. Five plugin apps' token-exchange failure and exception branches interpolated response.text / str(e) raw (dropbox, google-calendar, twitter-chat-tools, whoop).
canonical_prevention: Escape every dynamic string with html.escape(..., quote=True) at the interpolation site, and pin the failure paths with a manifest-registered hermetic suite that drives the real callbacks through a failing token exchange and a raising transport, asserting the escaped form and no raw script tag.
